description: This source file defines a filesystem-based job management service, including classes and functions to create, update, retrieve, and delete job-related data and files. It manages job metadata, upload handling, status updates, error reporting, and result storage.

classes.name: JobPaths
classes.description: Container class encapsulating filesystem paths associated with a specific job, including root, meta, uploads, work, and result directories.

methods.name: JobPaths _job_paths(base_dir: Path, job_id: str)
methods.description: Constructs and returns a JobPaths instance for a given base directory and job ID.

methods.name: str _now_iso()
methods.description: Returns the current UTC date-time as an ISO formatted string.

methods.name: JobCreated create_job(self, initial_status: JobState = JobState.PENDING, message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Creates a new job directory with initial metadata, including a unique job ID, and returns a JobCreated object.

methods.name: dict _read_meta(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Reads and returns the metadata JSON for a specific job.

methods.name: None _write_meta(self, job_id: str, meta: dict)
methods.description: Writes the provided metadata dictionary into the job's metadata JSON file, updating the timestamp.

methods.name: JobStatus update_status( self, job_id: str, *, status: Optional[JobState] = None, progress: Optional[int] = None, message: Optional[str] = None, result_url: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Updates job status, progress, message, and result URL, then persists and returns the updated JobStatus.

methods.name: JobStatus save_error(self, job_id: str, error_message: str)
methods.description: Records an error message and sets the job's status to ERROR.

methods.name: JobStatus get_status(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves current job status and metadata as a JobStatus object.

methods.name: None save_uploads(self, job_id: str, drawings_zip_path: Path, logo_image_path: Path)
methods.description: Saves zip and logo files to the job's upload directory, extracts drawings safely, and updates job status.

methods.name: Path get_uploads_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the upload directory for a specified job.

methods.name: Path get_work_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the work directory for a specified job.

methods.name: Path get_result_dir(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Returns the path to the result directory for a specified job.

methods.name: JobStatus set_result_url(self, job_id: str, result_url: str)
methods.description: Stores the result URL in job metadata and returns the updated JobStatus.

methods.name: None cleanup(self, job_id: str)
methods.description: Deletes the entire job directory and associated files to clean up resources.
